glosses: mattress (pad on which a person can recline and sleep)
buffer, cushion, padding (something acting as a cushion, especially to absorb a shock or impact)

examples.en: This is a very hard mattress.

examples.text: Yo quiero un colchón de agua.
María levantó el colchón para cambiar las sábanas.
examples.en: Mary raised the mattress in order to change the sheets.
